title: Aqua Mania Inc.

services.name: Home Rental
services.desc: This comfortable 4 Bedroom waterfront house is the perfect home away from home for the whole family. Located in Otter Creek (just a few minute boat ride to the main channel) and is walking distance to Alex Bay shops, bars and restaurants. This home offers dockage for up to a 38′ boat, Tiki Bar with grill, TV, sink, mini fridge and microwave as well as fire pit with Adirondack chairs. We provide all linens, a fully stocked kitchen and off street parking. This property includes the 4 bedroom home, a 1 bedroom apartment (separate building that is rented on an annual basis), storage barn, tiki bar, boat ramp and multiple docks that will be accessed by others. blurb: Aqua Mania offers new and pre-owned boat sales, including high performance, cruisers, and pontoon party boats. They provide boat rentals for day or week use with several boats available at their marina. Their full service department handles maintenance, repairs, and vessel appearance.
